#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# Installiert die GitHub-CLI aus der offiziellen Paketquelle (cli.github.com).
# Anmelden muss sich der Benutzer selbst (gh auth login) — CoreBridge
# verteilt keine Tokens.

install_user="${1:-ubuntu}"
if ! getent passwd "$install_user" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Benutzer '$install_user' fehlt." >&2
    exit 1
fi

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
keyring=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
    curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg -o "$keyring"
    chmod go+r "$keyring"
    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=$keyring] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list
    apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update
    apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y gh
fi

sudo -u "$install_user" -H bash -c 'gh --version'

install -d /var/lib/corebridge
touch /var/lib/corebridge/gh.ready
